instruction: Candid full shot in an indoor gym with grey mats. On the right, the man in the white t-shirt and blue shorts (R1) is seen from behind, facing left. On the left, the man in the grey t-shirt and black shorts (R2) faces R1, leaning back to execute a high right kick aimed at R1's upper body. In the background, a bystander in black clothing stands near the wall watching. The lighting is even and neutral from overhead fixtures.
